extracted.name: Mimi's Sugary Donuts
extracted.description: Great recipe for Mimi's Sugary Donuts.
instruction_lines: (Let me begin with I rely on my dough mixer a lot so) Using a mixer, add everything together,except "unsalted butter" and at first let it mix for a few minutes
When the dough starts to form then add "unsalted butter" in and wait until the process is done which take about 30 minutes
Proof the dough for 1 hour or double in size
Punch the dough to get rid of air
Cut it into smaller dough and roll into a tiny ball, weight about 50-55g each
Let them rest for 10-15 minutes or double in size
Dip your finger in flour and then make a hole for your donut
Fry the donuts until golden brown and then transfer to wire rack to drain the oil
Let it cool and later roll it with "granulated sugar" on all sides
